## Schema

`master_columns` records the exact ordered column list, so a consumer can detect a schema change without diffing a header:

```
dataset_id, row_id, seat_key, seat_key_unique, state, year, district, block, gram_panchayat, gp_term, ward_no, ward_name, tier, tier_local, caste_reservation, caste_reservation_local, caste_scheme, woman_reserved, reservation, reservation_raw, listing_scope, unit_of_observation, seat_candidates, winner, winner_basis, votes, vacant, unopposed, script, source_repo, source_commit, source_path, source_page, provenance_level, quality_flags
```
